We are happy to help. Email nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com and we will reply as soon as we can.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Open Google Play → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Nabeeh Plus → Cancel subscription. Or tap “Manage subscription” in the Upgrade tab of the app. Plus features remain until the end of the paid period.

I subscribed but the features are not unlocked

Check your internet connection, then tap “Restore previous purchases” in the Upgrade tab, using the same Google account you subscribed with. If the problem continues, email us with the order number from your Google Play receipt.

I changed phones or reinstalled the app

Tap “Restore previous purchases” with the same Google account. Your financial data is stored on the old device and does not move to a new one automatically.

How do I delete my data?

In Settings tap “Reset account and start over” to delete your data from your device. To delete the subscription record we hold, email nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com.

A payout date shown is wrong

We update the schedule by hand from public sources, so delays or mistakes can happen. Email us the correction, with the source if possible, and we will update it.

Refunds

Refunds are handled by Google Play under its policies; you can request one from the order history of your Google Play account.
